# MERG / PowerLux Copilot Instructions

Before substantive work, read and obey:
- `/AGENTS.md`
- `/merg_os/CURRENT_STATE.md`
- `/merg_os/PROJECT_REGISTRY.md`
- `/merg_os/PRODUCTION_GATES.md`
- `/merg_os/TOOL_ROUTER.md`
- `/merg_os/DEVICE_WORKFLOW.md`
- `/powerlux_os/CURRENT_STATE.md` for PowerLux-specific work.

Core rule: existing real source is canonical. Never create a mockup/replacement when the original implementation can be found. Never claim `live`, `fixed`, `deployed`, `connected` or `working` without verifying the real target system.

If PowerTV is referenced, do not reconstruct it. Its canonical Git source is not yet verified; original-source recovery is a P0 prerequisite.
